Eur. 6.2 (Hyoscyamus for Homoeopathic Preparations; Hy- oscyamus Niger ad Praeparationes Homoeopathicas). The whole, fresh flowering plant of Hyoscyamus niger. Protect from light. Profile Hyoscyamus contains the alkaloid hyoscyamine with varying amounts of hyoscine and has peripheral and central effects simi- lar to those of atropine (p.1219); its preparations have been used mainly for the relief of visceral spasm. The fresh whole flower- ing plant (Hyoscyamus niger) as well as the dried leaves have been used in herbal and medicine. Homoeopathy. Hyoscyamus has been used in homoeopathic medicines under the following names: Hyoscyamus leaf; Hyo- scyamus niger; Hyos. nig.
